summary: The r1 MAJOR is fixed. e2e/hint-observed.spec.ts wraps Worker.prototype.postMessage to record the `observed` of each recommend request. It asserts [] in hand 1. In hand 2 it asserts one entry per bot seat, in ascending order, each with hands === 1. Through the new records-harness log it also asserts that every stored user decision equals [] in hand 1 and equals the hand-2 hint payload in hand 2. Each of the three wiring points is covered: removing the counting at line 207 leaves the hand-2 hint at []; dropping act's third argument stores null, which fails toEqual([]); passing {} to the hint sends no list, which fails both equality checks. This matches the builder's mutation results in build-log.md. The records-harness diff adds one `observed` field to the log type, initialises it, and pushes to it in onHandComplete. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged. The reviewer re-ran the spec: 2/2 passed (Chromium and WebKit). Gate fix-6 has no failures.
